 Get involved Live Reporting
 Elizabeth Botcherby
 Show Most recent Most popular Get Involved - 'Arsenal are all over the place' published at 13:42 BST 13:42 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Watching Arsenal play these past few weeks, many of the players look like they no longer enjoy playing for the club. I think the loss of players such as McCabe, Pelova, Mead has affected team morale. Something needs to change.
 Hannah, Norfolk 
 Multiple clear problems with Arsenal. Squad still seems disjointed following numerous changes in the summer, and tactics are all over the place, everywhere on the field. It's like Slegers and the coaching staff don't know what to do with the size and individual qualities of the squad!
 Dan, Oxford 
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:40 BST 13:40 BST 
 HT: Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Ellen White 
Former England striker on BBC One 
 You've got to credit the Arsenal players for coming from 1-0 down. They've been sloppy. They've been huffing and puffing, not quite making clear cut opportunities. 
 The game is open. Anything could happen. 
 From an Arsenal point of view, 1-1 is probably fair.
 You can feel the pressure. It's how the players respond. Who can deal with it? Who steps up to the mark? Not just individually - but together. 
 1 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Get Involved published at 13:38 BST 13:38 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Do Arsenal actually realise this is a North London derby? No intensity.
 Simon, Isle of Wight 
 8 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:36 BST 13:36 BST 
 HT: Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 But Tottenham's joy was short-lived, with Georgia Stanway equalising for the visitors just four minutes later. 
 Media caption, 'It is a stunner!' - Stanway gets first WSL goal for Arsenal to make it 1-1
 9 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:35 BST 13:35 BST 
 HT: Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Cathinka Tandberg gave Tottenham the lead in the 13th minute, a thumping header from Victoria Pelova's corner. 
 Media caption, Tandberg rises highest to give Tottenham the lead against Arsenal
 6 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Get Involved published at 13:33 BST 13:33 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to send in your tactics questions 
 It seems only the Spurs players know this is a North London Derby, they are showing more passion and fight and feel they can win this game which would be severely damaging for Slegers.
 James, Herts 
 26 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:31 BST 13:31 BST 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Tooooot. Half-time at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and it's all square. 
 6 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45 mins 45 mins 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Lisa Baum and Emily Fox jink and twist on the right flank but don't put a ball into the box. 
 Julie Blakstad blocks off Baum's run to give Arsenal a corner, but the delivery is comfortably held by a leaping Lize Kop. 
 One minute of added time. 
 2 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:29 BST 13:29 BST 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Emma Sanders 
BBC Sport women’s football news reporter at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium 
 It's a strange watch. Arsenal feel like they want the half-time whistle to go. There doesn't seem to be much enjoyment out there. Tottenham are sat back and look comfortable.
 9 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 A few jeers as Tottenham's Eveliina Summanen goes into the referee's book for a late challenge. She had received a talking to for an earlier challenge, so not entirely unexpected. 
 11 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Get Involved published at 13:26 BST 13:26 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Arsenal - you sold the backbone of the team Katie McCabe (who wants to win more than anyone) and Victoria Pelova, who has been Tottenham’s best player in several games. What on earth were you expecting?
 Lyn, Norfolk 
 44 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 40 mins 40 mins 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Just about five minutes to go in the first half. 
 This north London derby was briefly sparked into life by Tottenham's opener but since Arsenal's equaliser, the two sides have largely neutralised one other. 
 4 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 37 mins 37 mins 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Arsenal's Emily Fox turns Alice Sombath and drives into the box off the left flank. Pulling it back would probably have been a better option than the cross - a couple of Arsenal players were shouting for it with their arms in the air - but good intent. 
 9 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Get Involved published at 13:21 BST 13:21 BST 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Arsenal know what Victoria Pelova is capable of, why are they allowing her so much space?
 Elaine, Bedford 
 29 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 35 mins 35 mins 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Arsenal restart quickly and Taylor Hinds sets off down the left. Unfortunately, she's completely isolated and is robustly dealt with by Drew Spence.
 The Tottenham captain is making her 216th WSL appearance today, moving level with Millie Bright at the top of the all-time list. 
 4 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 34 mins 34 mins 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Arsenal gift away possession again and Tottenham earn a free-kick. 
 Victoria Pelova sends a teasing delivery into the box but the whistle blows. She's at the heart of everything for Spurs. 
 4 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 32 mins 32 mins 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Tottenham players swarm an isolated Olivia Smith and launch another attack. 
 Victoria Pelova has a crack from distance but her skies her shot. 
 5 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Get Involved published at 13:15 BST 13:15 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of the page to have your say 
 It’s 1-1 but Arsenal look very nervy in and out of possession. Another week, another formation, another different starting XI. All feels so desperate and out of control.
 Mark, London 
 36 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 30 mins 30 mins 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Once again, Victoria Pelova is given a lot of freedom to waltz up the middle of the park. Alessia Russo eventually sends her tumbling to the ground on the halfway line. 
 8 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:12 BST 13:12 BST 
 Tottenham 1-1 Arsenal 
 Gilly Flaherty 
Former WSL defender on BBC One at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium 
 There have been a couple of times when Arsenal have won the ball defensively and have tried to do too much.
 Sometimes Arsenal cause their own problems by over-playing in certain areas.
